name: Village of Tuckahoe
gaps: Each district has two sets of rules: lots existing on or before July 1, 1999 (recorded as the main values, since most lots predate it) and lots created later (stored in post_1999_lots).

Attachment 2 schedule (dated 2014, 'for convenience') conflicts with the district text: A-5 coverage 35% vs 40% and FAR 0.45 vs 0.5; Residence B coverage 35% vs 40%; Apartment 3 FAR 0.8 vs 1.0. Text values used.
Text for post-1999 rear yards (§ 4-1.4.3, 4-2.4.3, 4-3.4.3) is misworded as a 'front yard'; the schedule's 40/35/35 ft rear yards used.
No impervious-coverage limit and no distinct corner street-side yard (front yard on every street; A-10/A-5 corner lots need 25 ft side yards).
No local wetlands or steep-slope law found in the Village Code.

wetlands.summary: No Village wetlands law found; NYS DEC 100 ft adjacent area applies to state wetlands.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope law; ZBA may allow garages 10 ft from the street where slope within 25 ft of the street is 12-20%, 5 ft where over 20%.

trees.summary: Ch. 21A: trees 10 in.+ DBH on private property - up to 2 per 24 months with 2 weeks' notice to the Building Dept; more needs a permit; under 10 in. free.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 7B and App. A Art. XII: SWPPP required for land development disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger plan).

adu.summary: No accessory-apartment provision; boarders/lodgers allowance repealed in 2009 (L.L. 8-2009).

general.accessory_structures: Sheds, garden/pool houses, playhouses, greenhouses: 5 1/2 ft from side and rear lines, 10 ft from the house; over 72 sf or 7 1/2 ft high needs a ZBA variance; not nearer the street than the house (§ 4-1.1.4(c), 4-1.4.5).
general.pools: Not nearer the street than the house; from house/side-rear lines/max coverage: A-10 12/6 ft/5%, A-5 10/5 ft/6%, Res B 10/6 ft/6%, Apt 3 18/10 ft/5%; 4 ft fence (§ 5-1.1).
general.notes: New or rebuilt one- and two-family houses need minor site plan review by the Building Department (§ 7-1.2). Fences max 6 ft rear, 5 ft side, 4 ft front (§ 5-1.3).

RES A-10.name: Residence A-10 District

accessory.notes: Garden/pool houses, playhouses, sheds, greenhouses: 5 1/2 ft from side and rear lines, 10 ft from the house; anything over 72 sf or 7 1/2 ft high needs a ZBA variance (§ 4-1.1.4(c)); accessory buildings no nearer the street than the house (§ 4-1.4.5)

RES A-10.source: App. A Zoning § 4-1.2 to 4-1.6; Attachment 2 Schedule of Area and Bulk Requirements
RES A-10.notes: Values are for lots existing on or before July 1, 1999; lots created later: 12,000 sf, 95 ft wide, front 35, side 20, rear 40 (post_1999_lots). Street line at least 80% of lot width. Front yard along each street line; corner lots need both side yards 25 ft. Height for 1-2 family houses: from average finished grade along the street wall to flat roof or midpoint of a pitched roof. Pools: 12 ft from house, 6 ft from side/rear lines, max 5% of lot, not nearer the street than the house (§ 5-1.1).

RES A-5.name: Residence A-5 District

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings (§ 4-2.5; Attachment 2 shows 35%)

accessory.notes: Garden/pool houses, playhouses, sheds, greenhouses: 5 1/2 ft from side and rear lines, 10 ft from the house; anything over 72 sf or 7 1/2 ft high needs a ZBA variance (§ 4-1.1.4(c)); accessory buildings no nearer the street than the house (§ 4-1.4.5)

RES A-5.source: App. A Zoning § 4-2.2 to 4-2.6; Attachment 2 Schedule of Area and Bulk Requirements
RES A-5.notes: Values are for lots existing on or before July 1, 1999; lots created later: 10,000 sf, 80 ft wide, front 35, side 20, rear 35. Street line at least 80% of lot width. Front yard along each street line; corner lots need both side yards 25 ft. Pools: 10 ft from house, 5 ft from side/rear lines, max 6% of lot, not nearer the street than the house (§ 5-1.1).

RES B.name: Residence B District (one- and two-family)

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings (§ 4-3.5; Attachment 2 shows 35%)

accessory.notes: Garden/pool houses, playhouses, sheds, greenhouses: 5 1/2 ft from side and rear lines, 10 ft from the house; anything over 72 sf or 7 1/2 ft high needs a ZBA variance (§ 4-1.1.4(c)); accessory buildings no nearer the street than the house (§ 4-1.4.5)

RES B.source: App. A Zoning § 4-3.2 to 4-3.6; Attachment 2 Schedule of Area and Bulk Requirements
RES B.notes: One-family values for lots existing on or before July 1, 1999 (two-family: 7,500 sf, 80 ft wide); lots created later: 10,000 sf, 80 ft wide, front 35, side 15, rear 35. 5 ft landscaped buffer (no paving) along side and rear lot lines. Garage space for up to 3 vehicles. Pools: 10 ft from house, 6 ft from side/rear lines, max 6% of lot, not nearer the street than the house (§ 5-1.1).

AP 3.name: Apartment 3 District

max_building_coverage.note: Principal buildings; accessory buildings another 10% (ZBA may allow +10% for garages); senior housing 40%

AP 3.source: App. A Zoning § 4-4.2 to 4-4.7; Attachment 2 Schedule of Area and Bulk Requirements
AP 3.notes: Any Residence B use (incl. one-family) plus apartments (7+ units), townhouses, senior housing. 950 sf of lot per dwelling unit; average depth 100 ft. Side yard = 1/2 the facing wall height, min 12 ft (townhouses 15 ft); senior housing rear 15 ft. Buildings max 160 ft long (220 ft senior/townhouse). Pools: 18 ft from house, 10 ft from side/rear lines, max 5% of lot, not nearer the street than the house (§ 5-1.1).
